name: desktop
//productName: Electron reads this for app.getName(), which decides where userData lives. Without it the config file would sit in %APPDATA%\desktop — named after the workspace rather than the product, and not where anybody would look for it.
description: The GYM desk terminal as a Windows application
author: FITZLY

scripts.//bundle:defaults: Bakes apps/backend/.env.local into the build so a fresh install needs nothing typed. Read the script before shipping this anywhere public.
scripts.//dev: Only tsc — the server bundle is a packaging concern, and in dev the window loads Vite while turbo runs the real backend on 7090.
